blurb: Guests can rent kayaks or paddleboards to explore Elkhorn Slough and Monterey Bay on their own after a safety orientation, or join guided tours to learn about local wildlife and natural history. Private tours and skill-building classes are also available. Rentals include gear such as lifevests and paddles, with options for splash jackets and wetsuits.
